content: Noma ORGAHI-ORHA'A Nhar lirni la re'eni wornu la'a Yunus.
Niwra: “Yunus pleta-plet pa mlia'awa la Niniwe, la letlawan de, pa mukot nohora ir la hya' maka A'ukot tiy o'a re.”
Noma Yunus natlin la ORGAHI-ORHA'A lirni pa nler pa nla'awa la Niniwe. Let de let sapon lawna id hade. Pede la'pa itiwra tawloh nana hota tala'a la lera wotelu memna.
La' ler tetema id ralamni de Yunus nala' pa nlola let de plahwani, na'nama nharlini pa nakot nohora Uplerlawna lirni niwra: “Tre' ma'ta lera terampwogat pa hota Niniwe namkoha-namnanni!”

Noma let de mniotni rpesiaya Uplerlawna nnio'oni de. Dewade leta mniotni honona retlia pa hota honona ratahan ya'ana, me kuku'uni-lalawanni rnairia rainia yaluli-yahona totpena rtutga de iriwra rhoitio'or doini-rtahnei dioin ir do'oni-halli.
La'pa ray Ninwe natlin tutga kot de dewade nerun la liwangenni. Noma no'lu doinia rain lawna lodna-hairi, na'nama nohga rain yaluli-yahona la inonni, me namtatna la awu li'ina wawannu.
Noma nala tita ida me nhopan pa riy rla rakot nohora riwra:

content.text: “Tit di de ray Ninwe nora mentrini re ed mak kalgota. De totpena rimormior rora nhiurni-wnia'anni honona la' let di de yan ra'ana-remnia hadomdoma.

Rimormiori rnairia naniayarni la inonni mak ktutga de rhoitio'or doin-rtahnei dioin oleka do'oni-halli, ne rweran targa nainiayarni mak emkade la nhiurni-wnia'anni wawannu wali. Riy honona hota rpolu-rwak rer lia' Uplerlawna. Honona re rhopliala hihi'ini-yapyapni yatyatni-halalli la'a ir rimormior wialli la'pa do'oni-halli honona re.
Twakwak de Uplerlawna pen neka Nhuria ralamni pa edonna Nwahla it do'oni-halli. Twakwak de Enherun doin hya' mak E Neti olek wa totpena yana tler la yatyatni-halalli yatlorni-yatra'ani!”

content: Uplerlawna Nlin reri-nmat reria hya' maka ha rhi'a re. E orgahani Namkeka de honona rolin doini oleka nhiolli-lietni mak khala re olekwa. Dewade E orgahani Nherun doinia hya' maka E Neti oleka wa, me edonna Nukmua re.
